positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Premium Team - Monetization, commerce platform and subscription fulfillment

positions.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack)
positions.description:
Helped this start-up to develop in-house tools, scaling up the existing infrastructure and migration from PHP to node.js and angular.js.

• Created a document automation tool which has increased the productivity by more than 300% for internal staff members.
• Increased performance of an existing tool by code optimization and optimizing HighChart rendering in the front-end.
• Technologies : Node.js, Angular.js, MongoDB, HighChart, MySQL, PHP, WordPress, Cron Jobs, CakePHP

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed the next generation virtual dealership prototype using Motion platforms and wheel controllers as input.
• Technologies: C#, VR development, Firebase Database, Oculus Rift, Microsoft Hololens
• I work with researchers here to create Virtual Reality Prototype for car simulations and other apps.
• Created a simulation environment for autonomous car simulation in Unity3D.

positions.title: Java Developer - Back-end
positions.description:
Key Contribution:
• Delivered CHAT ( Web tool for ICD-9 and ICD-10 code mappings ) and Bridgeview ( Provider Service Agreements) (as a Full-stack on both of the projects) and did several enhancements in other internal projects.
• Worked extensively of front-end techs like jQuery, AJAX, and JavaScript. Developed front-end for BridgeView project independently and guided whole team for UI issues.

• Handling client side development operation in JAVA language, gathering requirements from client and coordinate with the team to implement those requirements at off-shore. In addition to this, provide the client with necessary technical documents which includes design documents, knowledge transfer documents, etc.
• Working for Blue Cross Blue Shield MN, USA, who is a leading health insurance provider in America.
• Worked on various frameworks of java, to name a few Struts2, JSF, etc.
• Gained knowledge about US healthcare industry and HIPPA compliance, ICD codes, etc.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer - Intern
positions.description:
• This start-up has more than 40K registered users, with daily hits of 100K and has rooms in more than 130 countries.
• Developed two modules of the website to register Bars and Universities on Google maps. Fixed UI bugs and handled server.
• Technologies : PHP, WordPress, AJAX, JavaScript, GoogleMaps, MySQL

positions.title: Jr. Java Developer
positions.description:
Key Contribution:--
• Developed modules of a web application based on Distributed devices and related sensor’s data gathering, based on Java Spring framework.

volunteerExperiences.description: ISO SJSU is an organization based in SJSU. This organization, organizes cultural festivals and student activities on campus. I help the team with event management and coordination.

I was a part of Placement cell in L D College of Engineering. I was responsible to handle activities related to placement, which happens in college. This includes assigning interview rooms, setting up class room for screening or written test of companies. I was part of more than 30 such small to large scaled events on campus.

projects.title: UML Parser
projects.description: A tool which checks the source of java classes in a directory and accordingly generate class diagrams based on the relations between classes and interfaces using graphviz and PlantUML.

projects.title: Open Edx Configuration
projects.description: This project was developed for learning purpose and configured OpenEdx open source platform on AWS. Moreover integrated a UI theme to give different look and feel to OpenEdx.
